verses.text: The famine was hitting the land hard. ⚠️
After they used up the grain from Egypt, their father told them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.” 🌾
Judah said, “The man warned us firmly: ‘You won’t see me unless your brother is with you.’ ⚠️
“If you send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy food for you. 🧭
“But if you won’t send him, we can’t go. The man told us, ‘You won’t see me unless your brother comes with you.’” 🛑
Israel said, “Why did you make things so hard for me by telling the man you had another brother?” 😔

They answered, “The man asked directly about us and our family: ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ We just answered him. How could we know he’d say, ‘Bring your brother here’?” 🗣️
Judah told his father Israel, “Send the boy with me. We’ll get up and go, so we—and you and our children—can live instead of dying. 🙏
“I’ll personally guarantee his safety. You can hold me responsible. If I don’t bring him back and stand him before you, I’ll carry the blame forever. 🤝
“If we hadn’t delayed this long, we could have made the trip twice by now.” ⏳
Their father Israel said, “If that’s how it has to be, do this: pack some of the land’s finest produce as a gift for the man—balm, honey, spices, myrrh, nuts, and almonds. 🎁
“Take double the money, and bring back the money that was put in your sacks. It may have been a mistake. 💰
“Take your brother too. Get ready and go back to the man. 🧭
“May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, so he’ll release your other brother and Benjamin. If I lose my children, then I lose them.” 🙏
The men took the gift, double the money, and Benjamin. Then they went down to Egypt and stood before Joseph. 🧭
When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he told his household manager, “Bring these men into the house. Prepare an animal for a meal; they’ll dine with me at noon.” 🍽️
The man did exactly what Joseph ordered and brought them to Joseph’s house. 🏠

The men got scared when they were brought to Joseph’s house. “It’s because of the money returned in our sacks last time,” they said. “He’ll accuse us, attack us, and take us as slaves with our donkeys.” 😨
They went up to Joseph’s household manager at the entrance and spoke with him. 🚪
They said, “Please, sir, we came down the first time to buy food. 🙏
“On the way home, we stopped for the night and opened our sacks. Each man found his money right at the opening—the full amount. We’ve brought it back with us. 💰
“We’ve also brought more money to buy food. We have no idea who put the first money in our sacks.” 🤷
The manager said, “It’s all right. Don’t be afraid. Your God—the God of your father—put treasure in your sacks. I received your payment.” Then he brought Simeon out to them. 🕊️
The manager brought the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and fed their donkeys. 💧
They got the gift ready for Joseph’s arrival at noon. They’d heard they were going to eat there. 🎁
When Joseph came home, they carried the gift inside for him and bowed down to the ground. 🙇
Joseph asked how they were doing. “And your father—the older man you told me about—is he well? Is he still alive?” 💬
They answered, “Your servant our father is well. He’s still alive.” Then they bowed respectfully. 🙇
Joseph looked up and saw Benjamin, his own brother and mother’s son. “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” Then he said, “May God show you grace, my son.” 🙏
Joseph hurried out because his heart was overwhelmed with love for his brother. He found a private room and wept there. 😢
He washed his face, came back out, held himself together, and said, “Serve the meal.” 🍽️
They served Joseph separately, his brothers separately, and the Egyptians eating with him separately. Egyptians considered it unacceptable to eat with Hebrews. 🍽️
The brothers sat before Joseph in order, from the firstborn down to the youngest. They stared at one another, amazed. 😲
Food was sent to them from Joseph’s table, but Benjamin’s portion was five times bigger than anyone else’s. They ate and drank with Joseph, celebrating together. 🍷
